response.justification: Bogdan is a highly capable individual contributor and Staff Engineer with excellent distributed systems expertise and recent exposure to AI agent infrastructure. However, the candidate lacks the executive-level leadership experience required for this CTO role, specifically a track record of scaling engineering organizations to 30+ people, managing external delivery partners, and operating complex algorithmic trading or credit risk systems in a regulated fintech environment.
strengths: Extensive backend and distributed systems experience, including building high-throughput, low-latency microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Recent hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) code generators and agentic workflows.
Strong engineering craftsmanship background with a focus on TDD, CI/CD, and event-driven architectures.
concerns: Lacks executive-level engineering leadership experience; no demonstrated track record of scaling teams from 10 to 30+ or developing a senior technical leadership layer.
Limited domain expertise in algorithmic working-capital management, real-time credit risk, and complex trading decisioning.
Missing experience in designing and governing hybrid engineering models with outsourced external delivery partners.
